units.source_text: 雪过天晴，前院耀眼在目。

en.t: After the snow had passed and the sky cleared, the front garden shone dazzlingly before my eyes.

units.source_text: 那青年油光满面，肌肉结实，他背向这耀目的光景，冲着我的脸，将他呼出的带着威士忌酒味的白阿气吹了过来。

en.t: The young man, his face shiny with oil and his muscles firm, turned his back to that dazzling scene and blew toward my face the white breath he exhaled, carrying the smell of whisky.

units.source_text: 虽然这与往常一样，可是我想像着我在这种身量不同的人中间波动着的感情，也就揣惴不安了。

en.t: Although this was the same as usual, when I imagined the feelings wavering within me among people of such different builds, I became uneasy and apprehensive.
